chunks: And from him, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yusuf, and Muhammad ibn Ali, from Sa'dan ibn Muslim, from Buhlol, from a man, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: 'The best of women is she who, when she enters with her husband and removes her garment, removes her modesty with it; and when she puts on her garment, puts on her modesty with it.'
ai.seo_question: What is the characteristic of the best woman according to Imam Al-Sadiq regarding modesty and attire?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) defines the ideal wife through the dynamic balance of *haya* (modesty/shyness), illustrating how her external demeanor should shift contextually. While she maintains reserved modesty in public or general social settings, she gracefully sheds that reserve to foster intimacy and openness with her husband in private. This reflects the Shia scholarly understanding that modesty is not merely concealment but a virtue that adapts to the relational context, enhancing marital harmony.
